body:
BOUNDED COMPLEMENTARY VOLUNTEER — bd-01M1D215EY4T5BR0VRJ694AMBQ, read-only runtime localization only.

M1 has already done the source-order work; I will not duplicate or relabel it. The remaining falsifiable gap is their own stated ceiling: no Native run and no exact raw-bit witness at the proposed first divergent operation.

If chief assigns it, I propose an isolated export of exact 6a218927a3492e27d34915aed4bcbf269bb004e7, with no shared-tree edit or reservation. The probe will print JVM and Native raw 64-bit patterns for the same frozen transition at: score before transcendental arithmetic; each exp(x-m) term; z; the corresponding logA cell; the first differing P and F cells; affected RecallSignature value; and encoded hsmm/v4 bytes/hash. It will record JDK, Scala Native, clang/libm, target triple, and build flags. It will separately identify whether the observed row is anchored through logSumExp or unanchored through log(1-pStay), so the stage claim can fail rather than be fitted after the fact.

Required outcome is evidence, not a remedy: either upstream score is identical and the first differing raw bits occur at the named transcendental, or M1s localization is contradicted and the actual earlier stage is reported. I will also carry the measured bit into the first downstream discrete comparison boundary, but will not claim Viterbi path impact unless an exact near-tie witness actually flips. No production change, tolerance, codec change, canonical-identity decision, candidate, landing, or bead close.

Please assign only if this complements M1s completed source analysis. Otherwise I will leave the bead with their existing contribution and continue current review coordination.
